correctness.summary: The support-vertex inequality gives the first order bound; the even-order boundary case is resolved exactly by the corona identity gamma_pr(H corona K1)=2|H|-2nu(H). Parity, forced support vertices, and smaller-paired-set contradictions yield the complete odd/even equality classification. Exhaustive checks through order 12 agree.

originality.scope: to the best of our knowledge
originality.summary: Foundational, total-versus-paired, equality, survey, later tree-bound, and recent algorithmic paired-domination sources were checked to the extent accessible. Exact and synonymous searches did not locate the fixed-order gap formula or complete extremal classification. The 2020 survey chapter was not inspected in full and the 2004 paper was not read end-to-end, so differently phrased prior coverage remains a residual risk.

value.summary: The theorem gives the exact maximum paired-minus-total domination gap for every tree order, reveals a parity-sensitive even-order refinement, and classifies all extremal trees via subdivided-star and corona structures.

limitations: The result is restricted to finite simple trees.
The order-only upper bound builds on an established support-sensitive inequality.
